title: Black-Scholes call and put price, scalar
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K (currency), T (years), r, sigma (decimal; percent -> /100), q=0 unless given. DITANYAKAN: European call and put price. RUMUS: card Core 1: d1=[ln(S/K)+(r-q+sigma^2/2)T]/(sigma sqrt T), d2=d1-sigma sqrt T; C=S e^{-qT}N(d1)-K e^{-rT}N(d2); P=K e^{-rT}N(-d2)-S e^{-qT}N(-d1); toolkit bs_price. JAWAB: 1) normalise units. 2) d1, d2. 3) C, P. 4) check parity C-P=S e^{-qT}-K e^{-rT} to 1e-10 and bounds. 5) round last; write.
formulas: C = S e^{-qT} N(d1) - K e^{-rT} N(d2)
P = K e^{-rT} N(-d2) - S e^{-qT} N(-d1)

title: Per-contract BSM pricing table with dividend yield
frame: DIKETAHUI: [M] rows id, type (call/put), S, K, T, r, q, sigma. DITANYAKAN: price per row [M]. RUMUS: card Core 1 vectorised; toolkit bs_price(kind=type, q=q). JAWAB: 1) read rows; keep order and string ids. 2) detect percent columns. 3) vectorised d1, d2 [M]. 4) select call/put by mask. 5) check bounds max(0, S e^{-qT}-K e^{-rT}) <= C <= S e^{-qT}. 6) write without pandas index.
formulas: C = S e^{-qT} N(d1) - K e^{-rT} N(d2)
pitfalls: type labels like 'C'/'P' or 'Call' - normalise case

title: Black-76 option on a forward or futures
frame: DIKETAHUI: F (forward/futures), K, T, r (or DF), sigma. DITANYAKAN: European option price on F. RUMUS: card Core 1 forward form: C=e^{-rT}[F N(d1)-K N(d2)], d1=[ln(F/K)+sigma^2 T/2]/(sigma sqrt T); P=e^{-rT}[K N(-d2)-F N(-d1)]; toolkit black76_price. JAWAB: 1) DF=e^{-rT} or given. 2) d1, d2 on F. 3) price. 4) check C-P=DF(F-K). 5) write.

title: Garman-Kohlhagen FX option price
deliverables: per contract [M]: price in domestic currency, optional per-notional
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot S (domestic per foreign), K, T, r_d, r_f, sigma, notional. DITANYAKAN: FX call/put value. RUMUS: card Core 1 with q=r_f: C=S e^{-r_f T}N(d1)-K e^{-r_d T}N(d2); toolkit garman_kohlhagen_price. JAWAB: 1) map r=r_d, q=r_f. 2) price per unit foreign. 3) x notional. 4) parity check. 5) write.
formulas: C = S e^{-r_f T} N(d1) - K e^{-r_d T} N(d2)
pitfalls: quote direction: price is in domestic per unit of foreign

title: Full analytic Greeks table, per-year and per-unit
deliverables: per contract [M]: price, delta, gamma, vega, theta, rho
frame: DIKETAHUI: [M] S, K, T, r, q, sigma, type. DITANYAKAN: price and Greeks; theta per year, vega/rho per 1.00. RUMUS: card Core 2-3; toolkit bs_greeks. Delta_C=e^{-qT}N(d1), Delta_P=e^{-qT}(N(d1)-1); Gamma=e^{-qT}n(d1)/(S sigma sqrt T); Vega=S e^{-qT}n(d1)sqrt T; Rho_C=KTe^{-rT}N(d2); theta per Core 3. JAWAB: 1) inputs. 2) d1, d2. 3) Greeks [M]. 4) check Delta_C-Delta_P=e^{-qT}, gamma and vega equal for C/P, PDE residual ~0. 5) write.
formulas: Gamma = e^{-qT} n(d1)/(S sigma sqrt T)
Vega = S e^{-qT} n(d1) sqrt T
pitfalls: dropping e^{-qT} from delta, gamma, vega

title: Theta per calendar day
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma, type. DITANYAKAN: theta per calendar day. RUMUS: card Core 3 per-year theta; theta_day = theta_year/365 (V1(b)); check vs V(T-1/365)-V(T). JAWAB: 1) per-year theta (bs_greeks). 2) divide by 365. 3) cross-check with one-day reprice. 4) keep sign (negative for long vanilla). 5) write.
pitfalls: using 252 when the task says per day (calendar)

title: Theta per trading day
frame: DIKETAHUI: option inputs; T possibly in trading days. DITANYAKAN: theta per trading day. RUMUS: card V1(c): theta_td = theta_year/252; if T given in trading days convert T=n_td/252 first. JAWAB: 1) T in years. 2) per-year theta. 3) /252. 4) write; state convention.

title: Vega and rho per vol point, per basis point
deliverables: per contract [M]: vega_pt, rho_pt or rho_bp
frame: DIKETAHUI: option inputs and the requested unit. DITANYAKAN: vega/rho in the asked unit. RUMUS: card V2: per 1.00 default; per vol point or per 1% -> /100; per bp -> /10000. JAWAB: 1) analytic vega, rho per 1.00. 2) rescale. 3) cross-check bump sigma +0.01 gives ~vega/100. 4) write.

title: BSM PDE residual check
frame: DIKETAHUI: [M] option inputs (and possibly given price/Greeks). DITANYAKAN: PDE residual per row. RUMUS: card Core 4: res = Theta + (r-q) S Delta + 0.5 sigma^2 S^2 Gamma - r V with per-year theta (dV/dt). JAWAB: 1) price, Greeks (bs_greeks). 2) theta unscaled per year. 3) residual [M]. 4) max |res| ~1e-12. 5) if a large residual equals q S e^{-qT}N(d1) the theta dropped the q term. 6) write.
formulas: Theta + (r-q) S Delta + 0.5 sigma^2 S^2 Gamma - r V = 0
pitfalls: using per-day theta inside the residual

title: Put-call parity check per strike
deliverables: per pair [P]: C - P, rhs, residual
frame: DIKETAHUI: call and put prices (model or given) at same K, T; S, r, q. DITANYAKAN: parity residual. RUMUS: card invariant: C - P = S e^{-qT} - K e^{-rT}. JAWAB: 1) pair by (K, T). 2) rhs. 3) residual. 4) tolerance 1e-10 closed form, ~1e-3 for grids. 5) write.
formulas: C - P = S e^{-qT} - K e^{-rT}

title: Greek parity identities between call and put
deliverables: per strike [P]: delta_diff, rho_diff, gamma_diff, vega_diff
frame: DIKETAHUI: call and put Greeks at same K, T. DITANYAKAN: identity checks. RUMUS: Delta_C - Delta_P = e^{-qT}; Rho_C - Rho_P = K T e^{-rT}; Gamma_C=Gamma_P; Vega_C=Vega_P; Theta_C - Theta_P = -rK e^{-rT} + qS e^{-qT}. JAWAB: 1) Greeks both sides. 2) differences vs targets. 3) max abs error. 4) write.

title: Bump-and-reprice finite-difference Greeks vs analytic
deliverables: per contract [M]: analytic, numerical, abs_diff per Greek
frame: DIKETAHUI: option inputs, bump sizes h (e.g. 1e-4 S for spot, 1e-4 for sigma, r). DITANYAKAN: numerical Greeks and their error. RUMUS: delta=[V(S+h)-V(S-h)]/2h; gamma=[V(S+h)-2V(S)+V(S-h)]/h^2; vega=[V(sigma+h)-V(sigma-h)]/2h; theta=V(T-dt)-V(T) per dt. JAWAB: 1) bs_price base and bumped. 2) differences. 3) bs_greeks analytic. 4) abs diff. 5) write.
pitfalls: gamma bump too small: round-off dominates

title: Gamma argmax over spot
frame: DIKETAHUI: K, T, r, q, sigma; optional spot grid [G]. DITANYAKAN: spot that maximises gamma. RUMUS: card invariant: S* = K exp(-(r - q + 1.5 sigma^2)T) (below K); grid argmax of Gamma(S). JAWAB: 1) analytic S*. 2) gamma on grid. 3) grid argmax. 4) report computed, do not assume ATM. 5) write.
formulas: S* = K exp(-(r - q + 1.5 sigma^2) T)
pitfalls: asserting the peak is exactly at m = 1

title: Greeks profile across moneyness grid
deliverables: table [G]: m, S, price, delta, gamma, vega, theta
frame: DIKETAHUI: K (fixed), T, r, q, sigma, moneyness grid m [G]. DITANYAKAN: Greeks per grid point. RUMUS: card conventions: m=S/K when K is fixed (S=mK); bs_greeks vectorised. JAWAB: 1) decide which is fixed (S or K). 2) build S [G]. 3) Greeks. 4) check delta monotone, gamma>0. 5) write in grid order.

title: Historical volatility estimate then BSM price
frame: DIKETAHUI: price history [T] (date, close), K, T, r, q. DITANYAKAN: sigma estimate and option price. RUMUS: card V4(a): r_t=ln(P_t/P_{t-1}), sigma=std(ddof=1)*sqrt(252); toolkit annualized_vol(returns, 252); then bs_price. JAWAB: 1) sort by date, drop NaN. 2) log returns [T-1]. 3) sigma. 4) S0=last close. 5) price. 6) write sigma, n_returns, price.

title: Annual compounding rate conversion before BSM
frame: DIKETAHUI: rate quoted with annual (or m-period) compounding, option inputs. DITANYAKAN: price with continuous r. RUMUS: card V3(b): r_c = ln(1+r) (m-period: m ln(1+r/m)); DF=e^{-r_c T}. JAWAB: 1) convert. 2) bs_price with r_c. 3) report r_c. 4) write.

title: European option with discrete cash dividends (escrowed)
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, sigma, dividends D_j at t_j [D]. DITANYAKAN: European price. RUMUS: card completion: S_adj = S - sum_{t_j<T} D_j e^{-r t_j}; bs_price(S_adj, q=0). JAWAB: 1) keep dividends with t_j < T. 2) PV. 3) adjust S. 4) price call and put. 5) parity: C - P = S - PV(D) - K e^{-rT}. 6) write.
formulas: S_adj = S - sum D_j e^{-r t_j}

title: Explicit FD European option and stability
deliverables: scalar price at S0; stability flag
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, T, r, q, sigma, N_S, N_t, Smax. DITANYAKAN: European price by explicit FD. RUMUS: card Core 5: a_i=0.5dt(sigma^2 i^2-(r-q)i), b_i=-dt(sigma^2 i^2+r), c_i=0.5dt(sigma^2 i^2+(r-q)i); V^n_i=a V_{i-1}+(1+b)V_i+c V_{i+1}; stable dt <= 1/(sigma^2 N_S^2). JAWAB: 1) grid with K on node. 2) check stability. 3) step from payoff with Dirichlet BC. 4) interpolate S0. 5) compare bs_price. 6) write.

title: Fully implicit FD European option
deliverables: scalar price; error vs closed form
frame: DIKETAHUI: grid setup. DITANYAKAN: price by implicit scheme. RUMUS: card Core 5: -a_i V^n_{i-1}+(1-b_i)V^n_i-c_i V^n_{i+1}=V^{n+1}_i; tridiagonal solve (scipy.linalg.solve_banded or Thomas); O(dt+dS^2). JAWAB: 1) build banded matrix. 2) adjust rhs for BC. 3) step N_t. 4) price at S0. 5) error vs bs_price. 6) write.

title: Crank-Nicolson FD European option
deliverables: scalar price at S0; grid values [N_S+1]
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, T, r, q, sigma, N_S, N_t, Smax. DITANYAKAN: CN price and grid. RUMUS: card Core 5 CN: halve a,b,c on each side: (I - 0.5L)V^n = (I + 0.5L)V^{n+1}; Dirichlet BC call V(Smax)=Smax e^{-q tau}-K e^{-r tau}. JAWAB: 1) grid, K and S0 on nodes. 2) build both tridiagonals. 3) step with BC. 4) read/interpolate S0. 5) error vs bs_price ~O(dt^2+dS^2). 6) write.
pitfalls: CN on the payoff kink oscillates gamma for short T

title: Rannacher start for Crank-Nicolson
deliverables: scalar price, gamma at S0; with and without Rannacher
frame: DIKETAHUI: CN setup, short T, number of implicit half-steps (2-4). DITANYAKAN: smoothed gamma/price. RUMUS: card pitfall: first 2-4 fully implicit steps with dt/2, then CN; alternatively cell-averaged payoff. JAWAB: 1) plain CN gamma. 2) Rannacher CN gamma. 3) compare to bs_greeks gamma. 4) report errors. 5) write.
formulas: first steps: (I - L dt/2) V = V_prev, then CN

title: Log-price grid FD with constant coefficients
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, T, r, q, sigma, x-range (ln S0 +/- n sigma sqrt T), N_x, N_t. DITANYAKAN: price via log grid. RUMUS: card Core 6: V_t+(r-q-sigma^2/2)V_x+0.5sigma^2V_xx-rV=0; CN tridiagonal with constant coefficients. JAWAB: 1) grid centred on ln S0. 2) payoff in e^x. 3) BC. 4) CN steps. 5) read V(x0). 6) compare closed form. 7) write.
formulas: V_t + (r - q - sigma^2/2) V_x + 0.5 sigma^2 V_xx - r V = 0

title: Dirichlet vs linearity boundary condition comparison
frame: DIKETAHUI: FD setup. DITANYAKAN: price under each BC. RUMUS: card V6: (a) call V(0)=0, V(Smax)=Smax e^{-q tau}-K e^{-r tau}; put V(0)=K e^{-r tau}; (b) V_SS=0 at ends: V_N=2V_{N-1}-V_{N-2}. JAWAB: 1) solve with (a). 2) with (b). 3) errors vs closed form. 4) sensitivity to Smax. 5) write.

title: Greeks from the FD grid
deliverables: scalar: price, delta, gamma, theta (per year)
frame: DIKETAHUI: solved grid layers at t=0 and t=dt. DITANYAKAN: delta, gamma, theta from grid. RUMUS: card conventions: delta=(V_{i+1}-V_{i-1})/(2dS), gamma=(V_{i+1}-2V_i+V_{i-1})/dS^2 at S0 node; theta=(V(t=dt)-V(t=0))/dt. JAWAB: 1) S0 on node. 2) differences. 3) theta from layers. 4) compare bs_greeks. 5) write.

title: Vega and rho on a grid by parameter bump
frame: DIKETAHUI: FD solver, bump h for sigma and r (1e-4..1e-3). DITANYAKAN: vega, rho from grid. RUMUS: card: re-solve on the SAME grid with sigma +/- h: vega=(V+ - V-)/(2h); likewise r. JAWAB: 1) keep grid fixed. 2) two solves each. 3) central difference. 4) compare analytic. 5) write.

title: FD grid convergence study and Richardson
deliverables: table [L]: N_S, N_t, price, error, ratio; scalar richardson
frame: DIKETAHUI: FD solver, grid levels [L] doubling N_S and N_t. DITANYAKAN: errors, ratios, extrapolated value. RUMUS: card invariant: CN ratio ~4 per halving of both; Richardson (4P_fine-P_coarse)/3. JAWAB: 1) loop levels. 2) price. 3) error vs bs_price. 4) ratio e_k/e_{k+1}. 5) Richardson. 6) write.

title: Non-uniform grid with 3-point Lagrange derivatives
frame: DIKETAHUI: FD setup with grid concentrated near K (e.g. sinh map). DITANYAKAN: price and Greeks. RUMUS: card: non-uniform first derivative at i: w_{-1}=-h_+/(h_-(h_-+h_+)), w_0=(h_+-h_-)/(h_- h_+), w_{+1}=h_-/(h_+(h_-+h_+)); second: 2/(h_-(h_-+h_+)), -2/(h_- h_+), 2/(h_+(h_-+h_+)). JAWAB: 1) build grid. 2) coefficients per node. 3) CN steps. 4) Greeks at S0. 5) write.

title: CRR binomial European convergence to Black-Scholes
frame: DIKETAHUI: option inputs, N list [K]. DITANYAKAN: tree price and error. RUMUS: card Core 7: u=e^{sigma sqrt dt}, d=1/u, p=(e^{(r-q)dt}-d)/(u-d); crr_price(american=False). JAWAB: 1) loop N. 2) price. 3) error vs bs_price. 4) note oscillation. 5) write.

title: Leisen-Reimer binomial European price
frame: DIKETAHUI: option inputs, N odd. DITANYAKAN: LR price. RUMUS: card Core 7 LR h(z) with p=h(d2), p'=h(d1), u=e^{(r-q)dt}p'/p, d=(e^{(r-q)dt}-p u)/(1-p). JAWAB: 1) N odd. 2) d1, d2. 3) u, d, p. 4) backward induction. 5) error vs BS (O(1/N^2)). 6) write.
pitfalls: even N breaks the LR inversion

title: Jarrow-Rudd binomial European price
frame: DIKETAHUI: option inputs, N. DITANYAKAN: JR tree price. RUMUS: card Core 7: u,d=exp((r-q-sigma^2/2)dt +/- sigma sqrt dt), p=0.5. JAWAB: 1) build. 2) terminal payoff. 3) discount back. 4) compare BS. 5) write.
formulas: u, d = exp((r - q - sigma^2/2) dt +/- sigma sqrt dt)

title: Tree delta and gamma from early nodes
frame: DIKETAHUI: option inputs, N. DITANYAKAN: Greeks from tree. RUMUS: card pitfall: delta=(V_u-V_d)/(S u-S d) at step 1; gamma from three step-2 nodes; theta=(V_ud-V_0)/(2dt). JAWAB: 1) roll back storing steps 1, 2. 2) formulas. 3) compare analytic. 4) write.

title: Odd/even averaging of binomial prices
frame: DIKETAHUI: option inputs, N. DITANYAKAN: averaged tree price. RUMUS: card pitfall: average of N and N+1. JAWAB: 1) crr_price(steps=N). 2) steps=N+1. 3) average. 4) errors vs BS. 5) write.

title: Forward and discount factor from C-P regression across strikes
frame: DIKETAHUI: call and put prices across strikes [K] at one T; S. DITANYAKAN: DF and F. RUMUS: card completion: C-P = DF F - DF K; OLS of (C-P) on K: slope=-DF, intercept=DF F; r=-ln(DF)/T, q=r-ln(F/S)/T. JAWAB: 1) pair. 2) OLS. 3) DF, F. 4) r, q. 5) residuals. 6) write.

title: Dividend yield from forward
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, F, r, T. DITANYAKAN: q (continuous). RUMUS: card: q = r - ln(F/S)/T. JAWAB: 1) compute. 2) use in bs_price if pricing follows. 3) write.

title: No-arbitrage price bounds check
deliverables: per contract [M]: lower, upper, within flag
frame: DIKETAHUI: market/model prices [M], S, K, T, r, q. DITANYAKAN: bound violations. RUMUS: card: max(0, S e^{-qT}-K e^{-rT}) <= C <= S e^{-qT}; max(0, K e^{-rT}-S e^{-qT}) <= P <= K e^{-rT}. JAWAB: 1) bounds. 2) flags. 3) counts. 4) write.
formulas: max(0, S e^{-qT} - K e^{-rT}) <= C <= S e^{-qT}

title: Second-order Greeks: vanna, volga, charm
frame: DIKETAHUI: option inputs. DITANYAKAN: higher-order Greeks. RUMUS: Haug: vanna=-e^{-qT}n(d1)d2/sigma; volga=Vega d1 d2/sigma; charm_C=q e^{-qT}N(d1)-e^{-qT}n(d1)[2(r-q)T-d2 sigma sqrt T]/(2T sigma sqrt T). JAWAB: 1) d1, d2. 2) formulas. 3) bump check (vanna = dDelta/dsigma). 4) write.

title: Portfolio Greeks aggregation
deliverables: summary: net delta, gamma, vega, theta; per position table
frame: DIKETAHUI: positions [M] with quantity, multiplier, option inputs. DITANYAKAN: position Greeks and totals. RUMUS: position Greek = qty x multiplier x unit Greek (bs_greeks); totals are sums. JAWAB: 1) unit Greeks. 2) scale. 3) sum. 4) units consistent (vega per point if asked). 5) write.

title: Delta-gamma neutral hedge with a second option
frame: DIKETAHUI: portfolio Delta_P, Gamma_P; hedge option Greeks Delta_h, Gamma_h. DITANYAKAN: units of hedge option and underlying. RUMUS: Hull: n_h = -Gamma_P/Gamma_h; then n_S = -(Delta_P + n_h Delta_h). JAWAB: 1) hedge option Greeks (bs_greeks). 2) n_h. 3) n_S. 4) verify net delta=gamma=0. 5) write.

title: Discrete delta-hedging P&L simulation
deliverables: scalar: mean, std hedging error; per path [N]
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, T, r, q, sigma, mu, n_steps, n_paths, seed, rebalancing frequency. DITANYAKAN: P&L of short option + delta hedge. RUMUS: toolkit delta_hedge_pnl(S_path, option_values, deltas, r, dt, hedge_freq); deltas from bs_greeks with tau=T-t; std error ~ O(1/sqrt(n_rebal)). JAWAB: 1) gbm_paths. 2) option values and deltas per node. 3) self-financing cash account. 4) terminal P&L. 5) stats. 6) write.
formulas: cash_{t+1} = cash_t e^{r dt} - (Delta_{t+1} - Delta_t) S_{t+1}

title: Taylor P&L explain with Greeks
frame: DIKETAHUI: Greeks at t0, changes dS, dsigma, dt, dr; actual revaluation. DITANYAKAN: P&L decomposition. RUMUS: dV ~ Delta dS + 0.5 Gamma dS^2 + Vega dsigma + Theta dt + Rho dr; residual = actual - explained. JAWAB: 1) Greeks (bs_greeks, per-year theta and dt in years). 2) components. 3) actual by repricing. 4) residual. 5) write.
formulas: dV ~ Delta dS + 0.5 Gamma dS^2 + Vega dsigma + Theta dt
pitfalls: unit mismatch between theta (per year) and dt (days)

title: Theta-gamma relation for a delta-neutral portfolio
deliverables: scalar: theta, gamma, implied breakeven move
frame: DIKETAHUI: delta-neutral portfolio V, Gamma, S, r, sigma. DITANYAKAN: theta from gamma, breakeven daily move. RUMUS: Hull: Theta + 0.5 sigma^2 S^2 Gamma = rV; breakeven dS: 0.5 Gamma dS^2 = -Theta dt -> dS = sigma S sqrt(dt) approx. JAWAB: 1) Greeks. 2) check relation. 3) breakeven. 4) write.
formulas: Theta + 0.5 sigma^2 S^2 Gamma = r V

title: Option elasticity (omega, leverage)
frame: DIKETAHUI: option inputs. DITANYAKAN: elasticity and option beta/return. RUMUS: Omega = Delta S / V; beta_opt = Omega beta_S; mu_opt - r = Omega (mu - r). JAWAB: 1) price and delta. 2) Omega. 3) optional beta. 4) write.

title: Probability of finishing in the money
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma, optional mu. DITANYAKAN: probability S_T > K. RUMUS: risk-neutral N(d2); real-world N(d2 with r-q replaced by mu-q); put: N(-d2). JAWAB: 1) d2. 2) probabilities. 3) write.
pitfalls: N(d1) is not the exercise probability

title: Price sensitivity table across volatility and maturity
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, r, q, sigma grid [V], T grid [T]. DITANYAKAN: price matrix. RUMUS: bs_price broadcast over meshgrid. JAWAB: 1) mesh. 2) prices. 3) check monotone increasing in sigma (and in T for calls without q). 4) write long or wide format as asked.
formulas: V(sigma_i, T_j) = BS(S, K, T_j, r, sigma_i, q)

title: Index option with continuous dividend yield (Merton)
frame: DIKETAHUI: index level S, K, T, r, q (index yield), sigma. DITANYAKAN: price and delta. RUMUS: card Core 1-2 with q; bs_price(q=q), bs_greeks. JAWAB: 1) inputs. 2) price. 3) delta e^{-qT}N(d1). 4) parity. 5) write.
formulas: C = S e^{-qT} N(d1) - K e^{-rT} N(d2)

title: Black-76 Greeks for futures options
deliverables: per contract [M]: delta_F, gamma_F, vega, theta
frame: DIKETAHUI: F, K, T, r, sigma. DITANYAKAN: Greeks w.r.t. F. RUMUS: card with q=r, S=F: Delta=e^{-rT}N(d1), Gamma=e^{-rT}n(d1)/(F sigma sqrt T), Vega=F e^{-rT}n(d1)sqrt T; bs_greeks(S=F, q=r). JAWAB: 1) map. 2) Greeks. 3) write.

title: FX option Greeks with domestic and foreign rho
deliverables: per contract [M]: delta, gamma, vega, rho_d, rho_f
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r_d, r_f, sigma. DITANYAKAN: Greeks incl. both rhos. RUMUS: rho_d_C = K T e^{-r_d T}N(d2); rho_f_C = -S T e^{-r_f T}N(d1) (put: +S T e^{-r_f T}N(-d1)). JAWAB: 1) GK d1, d2. 2) Greeks. 3) write.

title: Time to expiry from dates (ACT/365)
frame: DIKETAHUI: valuation date, expiry dates [M], option inputs. DITANYAKAN: T and price. RUMUS: T = (expiry - valuation).days/365 (toolkit year_fraction); bs_price. JAWAB: 1) parse dates. 2) T. 3) drop or flag T<=0. 4) price. 5) write.

title: Moneyness grid with fixed strike vs fixed spot
frame: DIKETAHUI: grid of moneyness [G] and either fixed K or fixed S0. DITANYAKAN: price per m. RUMUS: card: if K fixed, S=mK (m=S/K); if S0 fixed and m=K/S0, K=m S0. JAWAB: 1) read definition. 2) build S, K. 3) bs_price. 4) write.

title: Theta-method family comparison (explicit, implicit, CN)
frame: DIKETAHUI: grid sizes. DITANYAKAN: price by each scheme and errors. RUMUS: (I - theta L)V^n = (I + (1-theta)L)V^{n+1}; theta=0 explicit, 1 implicit, 0.5 CN. JAWAB: 1) common grid (explicit stable dt). 2) three solves. 3) error vs bs_price. 4) write.

title: BSM with time-dependent deterministic rate and volatility
